data.body: Consideration: [Consumer impact] Read-after-write fence on tag set must guarantee VISIBILITY to subsequent /dso:preplanning and /dso:implementation-plan invocations in the same session. Document whether S4's local fence (commit to tickets branch) is sufficient OR whether downstream consumers (S5, S6) must perform a fresh fetch bypassing any ticket-CLI cache. Resolve in coordination with the ticket CLI's read-amplification semantics; spec it in the read-after-write fence done definition.
